mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_user_follow (follower_id, followee_id, created_at, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followeeId}, NOW(), 'app-user-center', NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user_follow WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_follow WHERE follower_id = #{userId}

SELECT user_id, user_name, nick_name, avatar, user_type, status, del_flag, bio, create_time FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0' AND user_type IN ('01', '02', '03') LIMIT 1

SELECT u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar, u.bio, u.user_type, 1 AS is_following FROM sys_user_follow f JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = f.followee_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND u.user_type IN ('01', '02', '03') ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar, u.bio, u.user_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_follow v WHERE v.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND v.followee_id = u.user_id) AS is_following FROM sys_user_follow f JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = f.follower_id WHERE f.followee_id = #{userId} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND u.user_type IN ('01', '02', '03') ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
